entities.name: Goat's Walk
entities.description: The jagged, cliff-lined southern coast of the Witch's Weir in Buzzard's Bay, blocking large vessels between Cape Hope and the Seafarer's Quay.

entities.name: Witch's Weir
entities.description: Body of water whose southern coast is the Goat's Walk.

entities.name: Cape Hope
entities.description: Landmark on one side of the Goat's Walk.

entities.name: Seafarer's Quay
entities.description: Landmark on the other side of the Goat's Walk.

relations.note: It is the southern coast of the Witch's Weir.
relations.quote: The Goat's Walk is the southern coast of the Witch's Weir
